newsitem.title: FRANCE: Worms board agrees St Louis merger.
newsitem.headline: Worms board agrees St Louis merger.

text.p: Financial holding company Worms & Cie said in a statement that its supervisory board had approved a proposed merger with food group Saint Louis.
The merger, which will take the form of a swap of one Saint Louis share for four Worms & Cie shares, will be proposed to a shareholders meeting on June 12.
Worms said the merger would simplify the company structure and make the group's share capital more liquid.
The company said its 1996 net attributable profit was up 15 percent to 1.0 billion francs. It plans a net dividend of 9.50 francs per share.
